name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €85/MWh on 10 Nov, easing on the week but above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route impeded
state: Dutch TTF gas was near €85/MWh on 10 Nov, 3.6% lower on the week and 18% below its 52-week high, but still above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Qatari LNG relies on the Strait of Hormuz, where weekly transits by ships not linked to Iran stood at 116 in 19–25 Oct, against 124 the week before (Lloyd's List Intelligence).
for_you: Wholesale gas costs feed into household energy bills and the Ofgem price cap with a lag of several months.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures
Lloyd's List Intelligence — Strait of Hormuz Brief: 5 November 2026

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
